_notes: THE FLIGHT LOOP, ALONE -- same shape as prismatic_orb_water_core.json: one
layer's folder, cut from fire_core_6f.png and nothing composed.
SIX CELLS, IN ORDER. fire_core_6f.png is 1536x1024 over 3x2 and divides exactly
into 512px cells, like every core sheet in this pack. No rects, no canvas, no
MEASURED: all six cells are a tapered, forward-pointing flame spearhead with a
white-hot tip, ink coverage 13.2-14.2% of the cell and NONE of the six bboxes
touch a cell edge (checked against the alpha channel at threshold 8) -- so
there is no clipped fringe to correct, unlike the contact sheet below.
LOOP SEAM: f0 and f5 read as the same silhouette (a compact arrow-flame,
identical taper and tip position, only the internal lick pattern differs frame
to frame) -- visually the cleanest loop candidate of the three new packs, at
least as clean as water's own six-frame core.
ALPHA IS MOSTLY BINARY like water's: 82.3% of the full sheet is alpha 0, 13.7%
is above 128, and only 0.8% sits in the 8-127 middle band, so the flame's edge
is a hard cut rather than a wide soft falloff -- no rectangle-against-dark-stage
risk the way wind's core has (see prismatic_orb_wind_core.json's notes).
DELIVERED WITH ITS OWN ALPHA; keyed is false, nothing re-keyed.
